Thanks — I reviewed Intercom’s model. Quick technical take from platform:
- Marcus: Intercom APIs cover conversational history and user attributes fine; where Intercom is weaker is bulk ticket workflows and integrations to our telephony provider.
- Migration effort estimate: 8–12 engineer-weeks for a staged cutover (messaging -> bots -> docs), plus 4–6 weeks of parallel ops validation.
- Risk: knowledge loss in existing ticket tags and macros if we don’t map carefully.

Proposal:
1) Renew Zendesk for 12 months to avoid coverage risk (take early renewal discount).
2) Open a parallel project to pilot Intercom on 10% of incoming live chats and measure OPEX impact.
3) Revisit consolidation at next renewal (2028) with a formal TCO after pilot.

Monica — can you request formal quotes from Gainsight on renewal terms and any ROI packages for success tooling (Gainsight is on a separate contract)? I’ll draft the pilot MOP and resource estimate.

— Ben
